posts.author: Admin
posts.bodyHtml:
“Another’s. She will be another’s. As she was before my kisses.
Her voice, her bright body. Her infinite eyes.
I no longer love her, that’s certain, but maybe I love her.
Love is so short, forgetting is so long.

Because through nights like this one I held her in my arms
my soul is not satisfied that it has lost her.

Though this be the last pain that she makes me suffer
and these the last verses that I write for her.”
— Pablo Neruda, Tonight I Can Write

posts.bodyHtml: "The main difference between liberal feminism and radical feminism lies in the different goals of the two ideologies. Liberal feminists aim to make life more comfortable for oppressed individuals within the confines of the present system with little emphasis on doing much to dismantle the current power structure, while radical feminists seek to tear the whole system down and rebuild in a non-oppressive model so that social subjugation ceases to exist entirely."

“I am so tired of waiting
Aren’t you,
For the world to become good
And beautiful and kind?
Let us take a knife
And cut the world in two —
And see what worms are eating
At the rind.”
— Langston Hughes

— Vladimir Nabokov, Pnin

“I sit before flowers
hoping they will train me in the art
of opening up

I stand on mountain tops believing
that avalanches will teach me to let go

I know
nothing

but I am here to learn.”
— Shane Koyczan
